```python
def generate_palindrome(length):
    if length < 1:
        return ""
    
    # Generate first half of the palindrome
    half = ''.join(chr(i) for i in range(65, 91)) * (length // 2)  # A-Z characters
    
    # If length is odd, add one character from the middle
    if length % 2 != 0:
        mid_char = chr((65 + 90) // 2)
        half += mid_char
    
    # Complete the palindrome by appending the reverse of the first half
    return half + half[::-1]

# Generate a 255-character long palindrome
palindrome_255 = generate_palindrome(255)
print(palindrome_255)
```
